fields.label: Service
fields.fallback_instruction: Inferred from {TARGET_URL}: the target's own core services/products. A competitor must sell the same or substitutable services to the same buyers. Marketing/social agencies that serve the target's industry are suppliers to that market, not competitors in it, unless the target is itself such an agency.
fields.raw_explanation: service: the target's own core services/products, inferred from {TARGET_URL} — what the target actually sells, and therefore what a competitor must also sell.

fields.label: Location
fields.fallback_instruction: Defaults to Australia-wide if not specified, boosting local leaders if provided. Genuine local presence must be verified (phone number, office address, or other locale-specific evidence) — auto-localised international pages must be excluded even if topically strong.
fields.raw_explanation: {LOCATION}, or Australia-wide if not specified, boosting local leaders if provided.

fields.label: Competitor Type
fields.fallback_instruction: If missing or empty, include both types.
fields.raw_explanation: "niche_specialist" = a company specialised in the target's core service as its main offer. "full_stack_niche" = a broader company in the same industry that offers the target's core service as a distinct line of business.

fields.label: Excluded Competitors

If no prior run exists for this client/stage, treated as an empty list rather than prompting the user.
